description: This file defines a smart pointer class 'scoped_refptr' for managing reference-counted objects, along with related functions and templates for reference management, adopted from Chromium's base library.

classes.name: scoped_refptr
classes.description: A smart pointer class for managing reference-counted objects, providing automatic AddRef/Release calls.

methods.name: AdoptRef
methods.description: Creates a scoped_refptr from a raw pointer without incrementing the reference count, used for objects starting with a ref count of 1.

methods.name: MakeRefCounted
methods.description: Constructs an instance of a ref-counted type and wraps it into a scoped_refptr.

methods.name: WrapRefCounted
methods.description: Wraps an existing ref-counted object into a scoped_refptr.
